items.title: Eli Lilly Shares Rise 2.8% After China Approves Orforglipron Weight-Loss Pill
items.summary: Eli Lilly (NYSE:LLY) shares advanced 2. 8% in pre-market trading on Thursday after China’s medicines regulator approved the company’s oral weight-loss treatment, orforglipron, expanding its presence in the country’s obesity treatment market.
